target_native_profile.entities: Passage, textual features (ellipses, focalization limits, hedges, tense shifts, narratorial refusals), a specified interpretation (narrator withholding knowledge), readers, textual versions or variants, reader responses or protocols.
target_native_profile.relations: A feature produces or cues an interpretive effect; features co-occur and reinforce one another; interpretation depends on reader expectations and genre; versions differ from a base text.
target_native_profile.processes: Interpretation forming across a reading; cumulative build-up of suspicion about the narrator; revision of a reading on rereading; foregrounding of salient devices.
target_native_profile.operations: Close reading and demonstration by quotation; comparing editions, drafts, or translations; in empirical reader studies, presenting readers with original or manipulated versions and collecting ratings, think-aloud protocols, or free responses.
target_native_profile.observables: Textual evidence quoted from the passage; the critic's own reading; in reader studies, distributions of reader ratings, coded free responses, reading times, or recall.
target_native_profile.inferences: That a feature contributes to or produces the interpretation, warranted by argued demonstration in criticism, or by differences in reader responses between text conditions in empirical literary studies.
target_native_profile.failure_modes: Circular or projective reading; over-attribution to a single device when cues are redundant; reader priors and genre expectation driving the reading; manipulated versions altering coherence, length, or rhythm; sampling and coding artifacts in reader studies.

source_transfer_profile.entities: Suspected factor = a selected textual feature or block of material; effect = readers' attribution of withholding to the narrator; subjects = blinded readers; conditions = original, omitted (dechallenge), and restored (rechallenge) versions.
source_transfer_profile.relations: Feature causally contributes to the withholding reading; the effect changes in association with removal or reinstatement of the feature; the association is established by contrast across versions rather than by demonstration within one reading.
source_transfer_profile.processes: The withholding reading diminishes when the material is omitted and returns when it is restored. Since readers cannot un-read, recurrence must be realized either as a fresh group reading the restored version or as the same readers re-reading after exposure, with carryover.
source_transfer_profile.operations: Omit the suspected material, collect blinded responses to the omitted version, compare with responses to the original, restore the material and collect responses again, checking whether the withholding attribution drops and then reappears.
source_transfer_profile.observables: Shift in the proportion or strength of withholding attributions between original and omitted versions; recurrence of the attribution after restoration; magnitude and consistency of the shift across readers or passages.
source_transfer_profile.inferences: A reproducible drop-and-return of the withholding attribution under omission and restoration increases support that the feature causally contributes to the interpretation; absence of change suggests the feature is not necessary or is masked by redundant cues.
source_transfer_profile.failure_modes: Readers attribute withholding regardless of the feature (spontaneous effect from priors or genre); omission changes coherence, length, or emphasis (concurrent change); readers exposed to the original carry the reading into the omitted version (persistent effect); redundant cues mask the contribution of any single feature; blinded response coding may not capture the specified interpretation.

entities.rationale: Features, passages, and readers are ordinary target kinds. Treating the specified interpretation as a measurable effect held by a population of readers, rather than an argued reading, is an extension already accommodated by reader studies.

relations.rationale: Critics already say a device produces a sense of withholding. Framing this as a causal contribution tested by contrast across versions sharpens but does not reorganize the relation.

processes.rationale: The source process is a reversible effect waxing and waning in one persisting subject. Readers cannot un-read, so recurrence must be reinterpreted as a repeatable state across separate readers or as re-reading with carryover. The reader's interpretation is treated as a different kind of thing: a reproducible population-level state rather than a single unfolding reading.

operations.rationale: Comparing versions is native to textual criticism, and manipulated-text experiments with reader responses exist in empirical literary studies. The ordered remove-then-restore sequence is a procedural variation, not a new kind of operation.

observables.rationale: Blinded reader response distributions are ordinary evidence in reader studies, though not in mainstream close reading. Using the shift and return of an attribution as the evidentiary signal is a modest extension.

inferences.rationale: Inferring contribution from between-condition differences is familiar in empirical literary studies. The added rule that reproducibility under restoration strengthens the causal claim extends rather than replaces existing inferential habits; for hermeneutic critics the shift from argued warrant to experimental warrant is larger, but still recognizable.

failure_modes.rationale: Spontaneous effects map to reader priors, concurrent change maps to omission side effects on coherence, and persistent effects map to carryover from prior exposure. Redundant cueing (masking) is a target-native concern the source frame must add. All are accommodated without reorganizing the problem.

naturalization.evidence: Empirical literary studies and psychonarratology (for example, textual manipulation experiments by Bortolussi and Dixon, and foregrounding studies by Miall and Kuiken) routinely alter text features and compare reader responses between versions. Mainstream literary criticism instead warrants feature-to-interpretation claims by close reading, and I have no evidence that the explicit remove-then-restore sequence is a standard design in reader studies.
naturalization.rationale: Practitioners in the reader-studies wing of the target would plausibly reach for version manipulation with blinded readers unprompted; hermeneutic critics would not. The specific rechallenge step is less established. This split kept the class above Native but supported Adjacent rather than Remote, since the core operation and observable already exist in part of the target.

classification.class_rationale: The transfer extends target practice: version comparison, manipulated texts, and blinded reader responses are already used in empirical literary studies, and critics already attribute interpretive effects to features. The main reinterpretation is treating the interpretation as a reversible, reproducible effect across readers so that restoration can count as recurrence. All essential source roles (factor, effect, removal, reintroduction, temporal association) have defensible target counterparts supplied by the packet or by ordinary reader-study measurement, so inquiry is extended, not reorganized around a foreign representation.
uncertainty: The target domain spans hermeneutic criticism and empirical reader studies; for a close-reading critic the displacement of observables and inferences would be closer to 2, and the class would sit nearer the Adjacent/Remote boundary.

Whether restoration responses come from the same readers or a fresh group is unspecified; the within-subject version imports carryover problems that weaken the rechallenge analogy, the between-subject version is a between-conditions experiment rather than a true rechallenge.
I lack evidence on how standard blinded coding of a specific interpretation such as narratorial withholding is in reader studies; the measurement is plausible but its reliability is unverified.
Redundant cueing may mean omission of a single feature produces no change even when it contributes, so null dechallenge results are less diagnostic in texts than the source frame suggests.

displacement.rationale: Most dimensions are procedural extensions of existing target practice; the one reinterpretation is recasting an individual's unfolding reading as a reproducible population-level effect that can disappear and return. Inquiry still asks which features produce the reading and still uses text variants and reader responses.

grounding.rationale: Factor (textual feature), effect (blinded reader attribution), removal (omitted version), reintroduction (restored version), and signal (shift and return in response distributions) each have target-justified counterparts, several supplied directly by the packet. No essential role depends solely on the medical analogy.

boundary_evidence.changes_what_is_done: Instead of demonstrating a feature's contribution by close reading alone, the critic sequences omitted and restored versions and collects blinded reader responses to each, comparing conditions in a fixed order.
boundary_evidence.changes_what_is_observed: Evidence becomes the drop and return of withholding attributions across versions, rather than quoted textual evidence or the critic's own reading.
boundary_evidence.changes_what_is_inferred: Contribution is inferred from reproducible response change under removal and restoration, with reproducibility strengthening the causal claim, rather than from argued plausibility within a single reading.
boundary_evidence.invented_counterparts: Recurrence after reintroduction has no exact counterpart because readers cannot un-read; it is reconstructed as a fresh-reader condition or a re-reading with carryover. This is a designed measurement with independent target justification, not an unsupported construction, but its fidelity to the source's within-subject reversibility is uncertain. No other counterparts were invented.
